content: MCP tool-surface design consensus: keep tools simple/composable (one action each) rather than exposing raw API 1:1; curate which tools are NOT exposed as much as which are; avoid returning giant resources (full inventories/DB dumps) — return bounded, purposeful payloads; load tool definitions lazily/on-demand (Anthropic reports up to 85% token reduction); add tools incrementally as real use cases emerge, not speculatively.
